title: 6.7 Integrals Containing Trigonometric Functions

icans: I can integrate odd powers of sine and cosine.
I can use power-reducing identities for even powers.
I can use identities for tangent and secant and for products like sin(ax)cos(bx).

notes: Odd power of sine: save one sin x and change the rest with sin² x = 1 − _______________; then let u = cos x.
